title: Classroom comprehensive end-to-end integration acceptance suite

changes.details: End-to-end multi-school / multi-classroom lifecycle integration acceptance test suite covering: School A & School B creation, source-locked lesson assignment publication with claim verification gates, student enrollment via class code, M-E-E work submission, teacher rubric evaluation with feedback and scoring, student inspection of evaluation, UTF-8 BOM CSV gradebook export, strict tenant isolation across schools and teachers (403 FORBIDDEN on cross-school mutations), and negative abuse guardrails.
Ensured /api/v1/classrooms/enrolled route is defined before parameterized /api/v1/classrooms/{classroom_id} to prevent path parameter matching collisions.

acceptance_criteria: 1. School A & School B setup with distinct teachers and classes: VERIFIED
2. Teacher A assigns source-locked lesson with rubric and verified claims: VERIFIED
3. Student A enrolls via join code and submits work: VERIFIED
4. Teacher A reviews and grades submission via rubric with feedback: VERIFIED
5. Student A inspects grade, rubric scores, and feedback: VERIFIED
6. Teacher A exports gradebook CSV with UTF-8 BOM encoding: VERIFIED
7. Multi-tenant isolation: Teacher B / Student B cannot view or modify School A data (403 returned): VERIFIED
8. Negative abuse guardrails: unpublished assignments (400), non-member submissions (403), fake join codes (400), invalid M-E-E content (422), unauthorized grading (403): VERIFIED
